Servo Output Status

Bit 0=SRDY (servo ready)
Bit 1=SON (servo on)
Bit 2=ZSPD (zero speed)
Bit 3=TSPD (target speed reached)
Bit 4=TPOS (target position reached)
Bit 5=TQL (torque limit activated)
Bit 6=ALRM (servo alarm)
Bit 7=BRKR (magnetic brake control output)
Bit 8=HOME (homing completed)
Bit 9=OLW (overload warning)
Bit 10=WARN (servo warning)
Bit 11=At Home
Bits12…15=Reserved

Absolute Position (Multi-turn)

When ID243 (P2.070) [Bit 1] is 1 (read the pulse number), this parameter displays the number of turns of the encoder (absolute position). When ID243 (P2.070) [Bit 1] is 0 (read the PUU number), this parameter becomes invalid and displays 0.

Absolute Position (Single-turn)

When ID243 (P2.070) [Bit 1] is 1 (read the pulse number), this parameter displays the pulse number of the encoder’s absolute position within a single turn. When ID243 (P2.070) [Bit 1] is 0 (read the PUU number), this parameter displays the motor’s absolute position in PUU.
